title: Stonecutting Paintings Magic
description: Choose between all available paintings (47 + 4 hidden paintings).
body:
Put the Painting in the stonecutter to gain access to all available, even the 4 hidden element, Paintings.

~~~~
~~~~

It's recommend to use **What Painting I'm Looking At?** to show directly what Paintings you have.

https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/wpila

~~~~
~~~~

By using **Notoito's Tooltips** you get a direct tooltip preview of the Paintings.

https://modrinth.com/mod/nitroito-tooltips
